reason: v10 reached C after A repair but two C responses exceeded design_brief maxLength=3000. This diagnostic adds opt-in concise C guidance and short, non-echoing maxLength feedback. It also permits up to 3 attempts per stage and 14 total calls, while retaining the 100000 locally accounted-token ceiling and 900 s wall limit. All other v10 settings, case input and safety checks remain.
scope: One 0.1.0 fixed A-F single-storey building case; no claim about four-case reliability or general scenes.
sample_policy: One run; every started call and failure counts. Preserve v1-v10. New live retries require a separately frozen batch.

success.machine: result.json succeeds, source geometry validates, WIR package round-trips, Unity GLB and Minecraft schematic are produced from the same revision, and exact offline replay reproduces package and target hashes.
success.human: Inspect one single-storey timber house, street-facing connected entry and reachable room. Target import and actual walking are not inferred from files.
success.report: Record calls, repairs, failures, elapsed time and provider usage. One pass is not reliability proof.

cases.prompt: 在一块32米见方的平坦区域内，沿一条可步行的街道建造一栋单层木屋。木屋需要一个面向街道的入口和一间能够从街道进入的室内房间。
